question: Priyanka walks 9 m towards the south. She turns left and walks 7 m. Then she turns right and walks 5 m. She again turns right and walks 9 m. In which direction is Priyanka facing now? (All turns are 90 degree turns only)
solution:
Given:

Priyanka walks 9 m towards the south. 

She turns left and walks 7 m. 

Then she turns right and walks 5 m. 

She again turns right and walks 9 m. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/09e9f3bce8487a3f28561bd2e2fe92d48c738db00eb58feae1de47829044f80a.png] 

So, Priyanka is facing at the 'West' direction now.

Hence, the correct answer is **"West"**.
